text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I was able to devote myself to training even more than usual,so it turned out to be a great experience.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The "Kobe Shimbun Hai,"
and the "Kikuka Sho" beyond it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I feel as though those victories
are gradually coming into view."
